from pathlib import Path
from hashlib import sha256
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from difflib import unified_diff
import json

site = Path('products/sites/shopify-catalogue-example')
index = site / 'index.html'
baseline = Path('products/distribution/catalogue-editor-example-placement/placement-live-readback.html').read_bytes()
preview = Path('products/distribution/catalogue-example-baseline-reconciliation/offline-preview/index-preview.html').read_bytes()
current = index.read_bytes()
proof = json.loads(Path('products/services/catalogue-qa/timed-delivery/rehearsal.json').read_text())
assert sha256(baseline).hexdigest() == '8bb6898a489669b02cd4db20f10abbe524a2d87b4c4590d233b49d337eb83bcc'
assert proof['synthetic'] is True and proof['answer_key_match'] is True
assert len(proof['findings']) == 2

class Page(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self, raw):
        super().__init__()
        self.routes = []
        self.scripts = []
        self.text = []
        self.feed(raw.decode('utf-8'))

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag in ('a', 'form', 'input', 'button'):
            self.routes.append((tag, attrs))
        if tag == 'script':
            self.scripts.append(self.get_starttag_text())

    def handle_data(self, data):
        self.text.append(data)

before, after = Page(baseline), Page(preview)
assert before.routes == after.routes and before.scripts == after.scripts
assert current in (baseline, preview), 'Site draft differs from both the served baseline and the existing preview'
assert preview != baseline
old_text, new_text = ' '.join(before.text), ' '.join(after.text)
for finding in proof['findings']:
    assert finding['sku'] in new_text and finding['observed'] in new_text
assert new_text.count('CAD') == old_text.count('CAD')
assert new_text.count('60') == old_text.count('60')
for finding in proof['findings']:
    assert finding['observed'] not in old_text
out = Path('products/distribution/catalogue-editor-example-placement/release-candidate')
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
diff = ''.join(unified_diff(baseline.decode().splitlines(keepends=True), preview.decode().splitlines(keepends=True), fromfile='served/index.html', tofile='candidate/index.html'))
(out / 'index.diff').write_text(diff)
inventory = {str(p.relative_to(site)): sha256((preview if p == index else p.read_bytes())).hexdigest() for p in sorted(site.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()}
receipt = {'baseline_sha256': sha256(baseline).hexdigest(), 'prior_draft_sha256': sha256(current).hexdigest(), 'candidate_sha256': sha256(preview).hexdigest(), 'candidate_source': 'existing offline preview', 'executed_control': 'TASK-179586216111', 'routes_equal': True, 'inventory_sha256': inventory, 'public_deployment': False}
(out / 'staging.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
index.write_bytes(preview)
assert sha256(index.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == receipt['candidate_sha256']
print(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2))
